translations.web: A voice came to him again the second time, “What God has cleansed, you must not call unclean.”
translations.bsb: The voice spoke to him a second time: “Do not call anything impure that God has made clean.”
translations.kjv: And the voice spake unto him again the second time, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.
translations.asv: And a voice came unto him again the second time, What God hath cleansed, make not thou common.
